# Image processing via ByteDance MediaKit CLI

Curated by Skill Harbor — @volcengine's image skill for the MediaKit CLI: 21 cloud image tools behind one command family — resize, lossy compression, quality-priority slimming, crop (directional, fixed, custom, circular), rotate, flip, round corners, color adjustment, sharpen, invert, gaussian blur, mosaic masking, face blur for privacy, text and icon erasure with smart fill, text+image watermarking, background removal with transparency, image OCR (Simplified Chinese + English with coordinates and confidence), metadata probing (metadata, avghue, alpha, blurhash), quality and aesthetics scoring, and smart cropping that auto-detects human and anime faces. It routes intent to the right tool (quality-first → slim-image, explicit size targets → compress-image), requires the shared skill's pre-checks first, and refuses to fake parameters or credentials. Honest caveats: **the skill is written in Chinese**; requires the `mediakit-cli` binary installed plus its cloud authentication configured (the tools run in Cloud mode — check your account's quota and billing yourself); MIT-licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
